'''Gatressa Mining Conglomerate''' was a corporation that oversaw the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]]. Following the [[Ruhnuk Mining Disaster]], the Conglomerate was forced to abandoned operations on the planet. The employee [[Fent Jucalla]] served as project overseer in Ruhnuk's mission.<ref name="CX" />
